plugins.name: creditgauge
plugins.description: Provider-agnostic Claude Code statusline plugin (CreditGauge) for token-plan usage and account balance. Picks the provider from ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL (currently MiniMax + DeepSeek); hides itself otherwise. Ships the :install, :uninstall, :clean, :clean-cache, :clean-journal, :reset, and :config slash commands.
